name: Deadfall
body:
School conjuration (creation) [wood]; Level druid 8

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Effect 20-ft.-radius, 40 ft. high cylinder

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance no

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

You conjure a mass of wood detritus and fallen trees to fall within the area of the spell. Each creature in the area takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage per caster level and is knocked prone. A successful Reflex save halves the damage and negates being knocked prone. If the spell is cast in a forested area, the damage increases to 1d6 per caster level and the target is dazed on a failed saving throw in addition to being knocked prone.

Afterward, the area continues to be covered by the debris. The area is considered difficult terrain and provides soft cover to any creature adjacent to or in the area, so long as the attacks cross a square occluded by the debris.
